ResearchTabDef.label: Arcane
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Study magical theory, practical arcana, spell schools, and forbidden arts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: arcane theory
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the first principles of mana, spell structure, and occult practice.

ResearchProjectDef.label: leyline sensitivity
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to perceive the subtle currents of mana that move through land, stone, and living things.

ResearchProjectDef.label: papyrus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study early sheet-making methods for preserving notes, formulae, and ritual observations.

ResearchProjectDef.label: alchemy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Refine plants, minerals, and reagents into magical compounds and restorative draughts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: runic inscription
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study stable runes, warding marks, and the carved grammar used to hold magic in place.

ResearchProjectDef.label: spellcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Organize practical spellcasting into teachable schools of elemental, vital, shadow, and death magic.

ResearchProjectDef.label: enchantment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bind persistent magical effects into tools, clothing, weapons, and ritual implements.

ResearchProjectDef.label: elementalism
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the fundamental forces of nature and their magical manipulation.

ResearchProjectDef.label: vitalism
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work with growth, healing, resilience, and the magical rhythms of living bodies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: transformation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the art of changing one thing into another through magical means.

ResearchProjectDef.label: illusion
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the art of creating deceptive images and sensory experiences through magical means.

ResearchProjectDef.label: summoning
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study the art of calling forth and commanding otherworldly entities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: parchmentry
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop durable prepared sheets for arcane notation, scrollwork, and practical magical records.

ResearchProjectDef.label: forbidden lore
ResearchProjectDef.description: Record the first principles of magic that most traditions refuse to teach openly.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pyromancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study heat, combustion, and the deliberate shaping of magical flame.

ResearchProjectDef.label: aquamancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Shape water into protective and hostile magic.

ResearchProjectDef.label: aeromancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Harness pressure, wind, lightning, and sudden motion through disciplined spellcraft.

ResearchProjectDef.label: geomancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study stone, soil, metal, and the patient strength of the earth.

ResearchProjectDef.label: necromancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Examine death, decay, lingering spirits, and the difficult border between body and soul.

ResearchProjectDef.label: arcane secrets
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unify several apprentice disciplines into deeper schools of colony-scale magic.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fleshcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Alter living tissue through invasive magic, trading stability for power and survival.

ResearchProjectDef.label: infrastructure
ResearchProjectDef.description: Apply arcane theory to practical colony systems such as wards, anchors, and mana wells.

ResearchProjectDef.label: soulcraft
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bind, preserve, wound, and strengthen souls through precise and dangerous rites.

ResearchProjectDef.label: planar magic
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reach beyond local space into other planes, hostile dimensions, and distant thresholds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: infernal pact
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study binding bargains, sacrificial power, and the summoning of infernal allies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: grand sorcery
ResearchProjectDef.description: Perform large rituals and endgame spells whose effects can reshape a whole colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chronomancy
ResearchProjectDef.description: Attempt the near-impossible discipline of stasis, acceleration, age, and altered time.
